name: CoScaf-final-best-H
scope: Four paper CoScaf-with-TTA highest-H single-seed records. Accompanying metrics come from the same H run, not separate CZSL maxima.
selection_basis: Descriptive official-test single-seed maxima; not validation-selected primary results.

calibration.fit_role: CAL only; separate source and adapted offsets; no test fitting
calibration.usage: Use source gamma inside adaptation; use adapted_evaluation.gamma for the adapted GZSL metrics. CZSL uses unseen-only raw scores.

archived_artifact_hashes.evidence_limit: Official receipt bytes read remotely and SHA matched to final native audit; model and adaptation digests read from that receipt; actual weight bytes not downloaded or rehashed

field_resolution.seed: Final seed; development seed is recorded separately.
field_resolution.source.epochs: Actual final training horizon, not development cap.
field_resolution.adaptation.topology_weight: Active at 0.25 for AWA2; explicitly 0.0 for the other datasets, preserving their original implicit default.

legacy_unused_loss.name: order_weight
legacy_unused_loss.status: No order loss is computed by the active archived or public adaptation path. The archived AWA2 value is 0; other configurations omit it. Not added as a nonfunctional public config option.

compatibility_limits: Public training.py has no epoch LR scheduler; the original fit used initial_lr * 0.95 ** (epoch - 1). A JSON key alone is silently ineffective.
Current public develop/train uses one seed and fixed source.epochs for both DEV and FINAL; the original protocol used DEV seed 7011, per-fold early stopping and a separately seeded fresh FINAL fit.
The public pipeline derives calibration from its own development output and checks exact config identity; it does not consume the frozen source/TTA calibration exported in this record.
Data membership, duplicate exclusions, cached FP32 features, backbone weights and preprocessing must match the archived run; JSON values alone do not establish this parity.
Public-code parameter mapping is provided for comparison, not a claim of bitwise parity with the archived implementation.
